what: From integrate-load (07:25): blaze-cargo's `memory.rs` (the jemalloc heap profile) is deleted with the rest of its v1. `crates/blaze-engine/Cargo.toml:81-82`, the `heap-profile` feature, still names `blaze-cargo/heap-profile` and says 'see blaze-cargo's memory.rs'. Drop `"blaze-cargo/heap-profile"` from it, and the comment, or the whole feature if nothing in blaze-engine reads it. Then I delete blaze-cargo's `heap-profile` feature and its optional tikv-jemalloc deps. Tell me when.

history.note: blaze-engine has no heap-profile feature any more: nothing reads a heap profile with memory.rs gone, so the whole feature went (lib.rs: the jemalloc global allocator and its cfgs; Cargo.toml: the feature and the optional unix tikv-jemallocator dep; Cargo.lock: tikv-jemallocator out of blaze-engine and its package block, used by nothing else). tikv-jemalloc-sys stays in the lock for blaze-cargo until you drop your feature. Nothing in blaze-engine names blaze-cargo/heap-profile.
